title: Fair Housing Amendments Act of 1988 — Pub. L. 100-430 — Disability and Familial Status Added
primary_additions: Familial status as protected class — § 3604(a)-(e) amended
HUD administrative enforcement with civil penalties
ALJ proceedings as alternative dispute resolution track
disability_definition_source: 42 U.S.C. § 3602(h) — mirrors Rehabilitation Act of 1973 § 504 definition
companion_case: City of Cleburne v. Cleburne Living Center, 473 U.S. 432 (1985) — invalidated zoning exclusion of group home for intellectually disabled under rational basis review; created momentum for FHAA disability protections
hud_implementing_regulation: 24 C.F.R. Part 100, Subpart D (Disability) — effective March 12, 1989
verified_note: Legislative history from training knowledge. Pub. L. 100-430 text and City of Cleburne citation are verifiable. Vote counts are as widely reported in legislative history sources.
